items.title: The Big Interview: Tim Lardner
items.raw_excerpt: Association for Project Management spoke with Tim Lardner, Regional Director for Europe and Central Asia at the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS). He shares insights on the challenges of delivering projects in war-torn countries, highlights the critical role of monitoring and evaluation in high-risk settings, and reflects on the transformative impact of inspiring leaders on communities.

items.title: AI ethics in project management: Who is responsible when the algorithm gets it wrong?
items.raw_excerpt: Consider the scenario: an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool flags a supplier as high risk, and the project drops them. Later, it turns out the model was wrong. So, who was responsible for that call? The challenge we have is that in most projects right now, nobody has a good answer.
